note: Header sections that are damaged rather than merely unverifiable. A missing or undecodable hash header and an unknown format version are all fatal; a line with no colon is not, because it never reaches the header map.

cases.name: Inspect Missing Hash Header
cases.note: Inspect reads the same header section, so it fails the same way rather than reporting a document it cannot validate.

cases.name: Verify Header Line Without Colon
cases.note: A header line with no colon never reaches the header map, so it is skipped and the document still verifies.

cases.name: Inspect Header Line Without Colon
cases.note: The skipped line is absent from the report, which is why this matches the plain single signature output.

cases.name: Verify Unknown Format Version
cases.note: A document declaring a version this build does not implement is refused rather than parsed as 0.1.

cases.name: Sign Unknown Format Version
cases.note: Re-signing reads the input first, so the unknown version is refused before any output is produced.

cases.name: Sign Onto Header With No Colon Line
Inspect Signed Onto Header With No Colon Line
cases.note: The line without a colon never entered the header map, so re-signing drops it.
